name: agentdial
description: Give your agent a real identity: phone, inbox, chat handles — one IDENTITY.md, seven channels. MCP gateway for managing agent identity, configuring channels (Telegram, Discord, Slack, SMS, WhatsApp, email, voice), and dispatching messages from Claude Code sessions.
author: Naman Parikh

mcp.description: Start the agentdial MCP server. Exposes identity management, channel configuration, gateway control, and the send_message tool.
mcp.install_hint:
Install globally: npm install -g agentdial
Or run without install: npx agentdial mcp-serve

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a recipient on any configured channel (Telegram, SMS, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, email, voice). The primary A2A-consumable tool.

tools.name: identity_status
tools.description: Get current agent identity — name, tagline, channels, gateway status.

tools.name: identity_setup
tools.description: Create or update IDENTITY.md with agent name, tagline, and backend URL.

tools.name: channel_add
tools.description: Add and configure a channel with credentials.

tools.name: channel_list
tools.description: List all channels with status, cost, and setup time.

tools.name: recipe_list
tools.description: List setup recipes with friction tiers and costs.

claude_add_command: claude mcp add agentdial -- npx agentdial mcp-serve
